candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations erroring with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed, and checkout p95 latency ~2425ms with 16 502s in 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Logs excluded from context.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with payment ReadTimeout errors in traces; inventory and redis succeed. Bounded candidate is downstream payment latency causing order/checkout failures. Payment-side telemetry and excluded logs are still required to confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs to confirm payment-side slowness vs network timeout
Excluded gateway logs (ev-8f11fb27c33d4815-r0-gw-logs) to corroborate timeout errors
